hello.speaker: seris
hello.text: My ancestor promised service for our bloodline. The archlord calls it inheritance. I call it a wrong that has lasted too long. I collect souls under that bond. Rowan’s power comes through me, but the archlord holds the claim beneath mine.

choices.text: Tell me why you cannot release him.
What do you owe the people you harmed?

truth.speaker: seris
truth.text: If I cancel his pact alone, the superior claim takes effect. Protecting him does not make keeping him right. I love him. That gives me no right to decide his life. Let him see every clause.

past.speaker: seris
past.text: I remember Mara, a ferryman whose name I entered in that ledger. Fear explains why I obeyed; it does not repair what I did. Preserve her testimony, even if it is evidence against me.
